next_experiment.reason: Domain is the open component common to both quantities (drag 0.01575, Strouhal 0.0179, both marginally above 0.015). Expanding R2 by 2.0 gives cumulative 4x, within the limit. That makes a constant-ratio sequence (1x, 2x, 4x) and tests whether the trend flattens. It is cheap (3746 s) and fits the remaining budget. R3 is not allowed as parent (cumulative limit 4.0). R1 is not allowed (cell limit).
next_experiment.expected_outcome: If the Cd and St change from R2 to the new run is clearly smaller than the R0-to-R2 change (0.91% drag, 0.52% Strouhal in total so far), the observed domain order becomes sensible and the domain uncertainty drops to 0.015 or below. A monotonic trend with a small change confirms the domain is controlled. A non-monotonic trend or a change above 3% means the domain is not converged.
